title: Sphodrias
summary: Raleigh names Sphodrias in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Sphodrias, left at Thespies by Cleombrotus, whose attempt vpon the Hauen of Athens drew the Athenians into the Warre. The printed spelling is kept. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book III, Part I, Chapter XI, §. XI, sig. 452a–452b
